niche: a combined authority's adult skills team choosing which of six delivery partners' models to scale for the 2027 funded place allocation, from two intakes of ballot-rationed place offers, waitlist re-offers that lapse at the enrolment census date, and qualification achievement records
analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms both intakes' enrolment layouts, resolves the learner identifiers across the provider merger, reads every field and the allocation policy correctly, uses the ballot rather than attendance so the contrast is randomised, and counts every offer the records hold rather than first-round offers alone, expresses each partner's effect per learner offered a place and files Brenlow at 13.7 additional achievements per 100, with Dunthorpe fourth of six; the golden is Dunthorpe at 19.4 per 100 funded places
domain_test: The deciding quantity is what one funded place delivers in additional qualification achievements, estimated the way programme evaluation estimates a rationed offer (a within-partner contrast on the place ballot, carried to the unit the commissioner buys). The noun swap breaks it because the place is funded before the learner decides, a refused place can only be re-offered until the enrolment census date closes the intake, and the achievement is awarded on the academic cycle: swap in hospital beds or megawatt-hours and there is no census date that strands a bought unit unused, so nothing separates a funded unit from a used one

stakeholder_role: the commissioning manager in a combined authority's adult skills team, who puts the 2027 partner slate to the authority's assembly

spine.entity: one application to one partner for one intake, with its ballot rank and the offers made against it

world.geography: an unnamed combined authority area in England
world.org_type: a combined authority commissioning adult education places from six delivery partners

driver: The decisive quantity is what one funded unit delivers, where the buyer commits the unit before the recipient decides and a refused unit can be passed on only until a fixed calendar date closes the cycle, so the share of funded units ever taken up runs from under a half to nearly all across the candidates; an effect estimated per unit taken up, however cleanly identified from the random rationing, ranks the candidates by their effect on a recipient rather than by what the buyer's committed unit returns.
driver_concrete: Each partner's place offers were rationed by ballot, so every partner carries a randomised contrast, but a refused place can only be re-offered down the ballot until the enrolment census date, and the partners differ enormously in how much of that waitlist they work (fill rates 0.455 to 0.963). The commissioner buys places, so the deciding figure is additional achievements per 100 funded places, which needs each partner's fill rate measured from the allocation records; no document publishes it.
stump: A competent analyst uses the ballot, builds a clean offer contrast and reports each partner's effect per learner offered, naming Brenlow at 13.7 per 100 and placing Dunthorpe fourth of six, because that figure prices the effect on a learner who takes a place rather than the return on a place the authority funds; Dunthorpe's waitlist fills 96 per cent of its places against Brenlow's 64, and per 100 funded places Dunthorpe returns 19.4 against Brenlow's 16.1.

differentiation.task266: task266 estimates the share of spells ending one way when others end differently and some are still open, so its decisive step is the cumulative incidence against a product-limit estimate: a survival estimator choice. This build's outcome is observed for everyone in both intakes and carries no censoring; the decisive step is the unit the effect is expressed in.
differentiation.task268: task268 carries each lost unit's survival from the state it was in when lost, an informative-censoring correction. Nothing here is lost to follow-up: the never-offered applicants are in the records throughout.
differentiation.task44: task44's pooled effect is a mixture of opposite effects split by a moderator in no column, so its step is a decomposition. Here each partner's effect is homogeneous within the partner and the gradient across partners is visible; what decides is the denominator the commissioner funds, which no decomposition reveals.
differentiation.task83: task83 conditions a holdout's effect on each unit's own prior treatment history because the target pool's mix differs. This build carries no effect onto another population: the call is among the same partners that were balloted.
differentiation.task12: task12 and task15 recover a population the records hide. Nothing is hidden here: every offer, every ballot rank and every funded place is shipped, and the step is what to divide by.
differentiation.task270: task270 v6 recovers where an item sold without a fixed slot actually landed, because the landing record shows only the items that stayed in the slot they were sold for, so one join over a coverage gap reverses the choice and the judge read the moved bookings as a planted flip. Nothing in this build is mis-recorded or absent: every funded place, every ballot rank, every offer and every achievement is shipped and reconciles, no join reveals a misplacement, and the step is not finding where a unit went but choosing what the per-100 figure is divided by, funded places against learners who took one up.

lineage.layer2_pattern: own:concordance by distribution matching, not regression
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many units fall below a cut on a new instrument's scale when part of the population was measured only on the old instrument; a sample measured on both links the scales, and predicting each unit's new value by regression shrinks every converted value toward the sample's mean, so the converted spread is too narrow and the tail beyond the cut too thin, while matching the percentiles of two groups each measured on one instrument assumes the groups are alike; only a conversion that matches the two instruments' distributions in the sample measured on both keeps the share beyond the cut.
lineage.fate: spent on the portal 2026-10-27: both responses landed the call and one filed the runner-up and the gap exactly; the decisive step was the field's own named method for the deciding quantity, so no competent reflex was stopped by it

lineage.layer2_pattern: own:weather-normalized emissions on the current operating regime
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is each unit's output in a standard year of an external driver as the unit now operates, estimated from a response model fitted on the unit's own record; partway through the record many units changed how they respond to the driver or how much they draw regardless of it, on dates no file records, so a model fitted over the whole record or over the latest twelve months, or one recent year scaled by the driver's ratio, misstates the units whose response changed or whose fixed draw does not scale, and each moves a different set of units across the cap.
lineage.fate: judge SEND_BACK 2026-10-17 (NOT_DETERMINISTIC: the post-change window's first span and whether electricity is refit with the heating fuel unforced)

spent 2026-10-27 at the stage 4 re-judge on Gate C, and its world then measured closed; architecture 4 screened the author's fixed education-and-ETL pairing and refused all four candidate decisive steps on measured arithmetic; architecture 5 screened all six ETL cells in the taxonomy and refused or barred every one, which closed the ETL objective for this number
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how much a set of units can deliver in a forward period, and each unit's deliverable positions are fewer than the positions it reports because some of them cannot be worked at the same time, a ceiling no file states and no attestation reflects; the ceiling is fixed exactly by the greatest number of the unit's own timed service intervals that have ever run together, repeated in every period of a long record, so multiplying reported positions by staffed sessions overstates the total and overstates it most at the units whose ceiling is lowest.

notes: Re-rooted 2026-10-27 to architecture 6 after the ETL objective closed for this number (architecture 5 screened all six ETL cells and refused or barred every one; ETL carries 66 cards across six cells and is the only objective with no never-drawn cell). experiment-causal is the least-spent objective, 9 cards and 30 of 32 cells never drawn. education-learning-sciences x experiment-causal is a never-built pairing and randomized-quasi-experimental-program-evaluation a never-drawn cell. MEASURED AT THE DRAW: the specification-extension law closes adding a control, level, interaction or random effect as a class, so the decisive step is the estimand, which CLAUDE.md blesses. Family screen over 304 cards: per-offer against per-attender 0 hits, effect per place 0 hits, while transport (43, 44, 83), population recovery (12, 15), competing risks (266), informative censoring (268, 184, 487, 308) and staggered adoption (9 cards) are spent. Ladder measured on individual-level data: rung 0 participants against non-participants names Brenlow, rung 1 ballot winners who enrolled against losers names Calderwick, rung 2 the first-round ballot ITT names Calderwick, rung 2b that ITT grossed per place names Brenlow, the clean per-offer contrast names Brenlow, and the golden per 100 funded places names Dunthorpe at a margin of 1.207. The golden sits 4th of 6 on rungs 0, 1 and 2b and 5th on rung 2. Bin test at a bin of 1.0 per 100 places: (a) 7.98, (b) 0.000 because golden equals 100 x offers-ever-made over places-funded x the clean contrast and has no free parameter, (c) 3.18, ratio 2.51, and (a) is not the smallest rung gap. Call stability 287 of 300 draws. Strategy key: causal_design and grain_or_unit are both banned on this window, and population_selection is the honest key for the decisive step, which is what the per-100 figure is divided by (funded places against learners who took a place), with places never taken up as the exposure that differs by partner. Decisive generator is G9, downstream survival against upstream acquisition: the authority funds places and only some survive to an enrolment, the surviving share running 0.455 to 0.963 by partner. G1, the unit of value, is the consequence, which figure the per-100 is divided by. Gate G mechanism is binding_constraint, not method_or_model_selection: no method is selected here, which is why the licensed-family spread measures 0.000 bins. What binds is the enrolment census date, a service limit that stops a refused place being passed further down the ballot, which is why a funded place at one partner strands and at another fills, and it is what removes the natural pick.
